title: How to Run Your First AI Coding Agent in a Docker Sandbox
description: A step-by-step tutorial on running Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding agents inside an isolated Docker sandbox — microVM isolation, network policies, and a private Docker daemon.

title: MicroVMs vs Containers vs Full VMs: The Architecture Behind Docker Sandboxes
description: A technical deep dive comparing full VMs, containers, Docker-in-Docker, and microVMs — why DinD breaks isolation guarantees for autonomous agents, and the cold-start/overhead tradeoffs that make microVMs the sweet spot.

title: Docker Sandboxes vs Docker AI Governance: What Each One Actually Does
description: Docker Sandboxes and Docker AI Governance solve different-scoped problems — per-agent isolation versus org-wide policy. A clear breakdown of when you need one, both, and what the kit format still can't do yet.

title: Beyond AI Agents: Other Uses for Docker Sandboxes
description: Docker Sandboxes were built for autonomous coding agents, but the same microVM isolation applies to malware analysis, untrusted third-party code, and ephemeral CI — with different network policy choices for each.

title: Building Your First Agentic Stack with Docker Compose
description: A step-by-step tutorial on defining a model, an MCP Gateway, and a LangGraph agent together in one compose.yaml — and launching the whole stack with a single docker compose up.
